SELECT atom_id as atom, COUNT(*) as bond_count FROM (
    SELECT atom_id FROM csv WHERE atom_id IN ('TR110_2', 'TR110_3', 'TR110_4', 'TR340_26', 'TR340_44', 'TR340_8')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT atom_id2 FROM csv WHERE atom_id2 IN ('TR110_2', 'TR110_3', 'TR110_4', 'TR340_26', 'TR340_44', 'TR340_8')
) GROUP BY atom ORDER BY atom
